all_part_contact_graph.method: Full semantic-part graph using actual vertex/triangle boundaries, enclosed points, edge/triangle and coplanar-edge intersections. AABB only rejects separated pairs; it never establishes contact.
all_part_contact_graph.limits: Geometric connectivity, not structural design, attachment strength, irrigation, load, or simulation behavior. Open folded foliage is not treated as a closed support hull.
